description: This PHP source file implements the web interface for configuring Remote Management and Remote Access settings on a network gateway device. It includes server-side logic to retrieve current configuration parameters, as well as client-side JavaScript for user interaction, validation, and submitting configuration changes via AJAX.

methods.name: remote_access_block
methods.description: Disables all IP address input fields and options for remote access restriction when remote management is disabled.

methods.name: remote_access_allowe
methods.description: Enables or disables the remote access input fields based on current toggle states, showing or hiding warning messages.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks whether all input fields with a specific prefix are empty.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates values of input fields with a specified prefix into a single address string separated by a specified separator.
